skills.name: Transformation Scythe (化生戟)
skills.description: Garuda attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of his ATK and Valuable Feather on the target will be consumed. ; Valuable Feather (惜羽) : :'''Debuff, Mark''': When the move bar for an inflicted enemy is increased, and if he is not immobile, Garuda will launch 1 normal attack at them.

skills.name: Heavenly Wings (天衣妙翅)
skills.line: As you can see, my wings are as sharp as blades.
skills.description:
When Garuda uses his normal or special attacks, he'll deal an additional 20% of damage to enemies with shields.
Exclusive effect. At the end of an enemy's turn, Garuda has a 7% chance to inflict all enemies with Valuable Feather. ; : ; Valuable Feather (惜羽) : :'''Debuff, Mark''': When the move bar for an inflicted enemy is increased, and if he is not immobile, Garuda will launch 1 normal attack at them.

upgrades.text: When this skill doesn't trigger 5 times in a row, and if he is not inflicted with any control effects, Burning Feathers is immediately used without any onibi.

skills.name: Burning Feathers (龍息燼羽)
skills.line: I believe in 'quit while you're ahead'.
skills.description: Garuda attacks all enemies dealing damage equal to 134% of his ATK and has a 40% base chance to inflict them with Valuable Feather. ; Valuable Feather (惜羽) : :'''Debuff, Mark''': When the move bar for an inflicted enemy is increased, and if he is not immobile, Garuda will launch 1 normal attack at them.

upgrades.text: When using this skill, enemies are guaranteed to be inflicted with Valuable Feather.

bio.condition: Team Garuda with another player's Asura and clear any zone 10 times.
Wish for 10 Garuda shards in guild.
